segments.normalizedSource: ```swift TabView { TabSection("Messages") { ForEach(store.messageCategories) { category in Tab(category.title, image: category.image) .swipeActions(edge: .leading) { Button { store.toggleUnread(category) } label: { if category.isUnread { Label("Read", systemImage: "envelope.open") } else { Label("Unread", systemImage: "envelope.badge") } } } .swipeActions(edge: .trailing) { Button(role: .destructive) { store.hide(category) } label: { Label("Remove", systemImage: "trash") } Button { store.flag(category) } label: { Label("Flag", systemImage: "flag") } } } } } } ```
